name: Banana Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Butter a 4x8 inch loaf pan.
Mash bananas thoroughly in a large bowl.
Stir in sugar, beaten egg, and vanilla.
Add baking soda and salt. Mix well.
Fold in flour until just combined. Do not overmix.
Fold in chocolate chips if using.
Pour into loaf pan. Bake 55-65 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool in pan 10 minutes then transfer to a wire rack.

substitutions.dairy_free: Use melted coconut oil instead of butter.
substitutions.vegan: Use coconut oil and a flax egg (1 tbsp ground flax + 3 tbsp water).
substitutions.low_carb: Use almond flour, reduce sugar to 2 tbsp and add 1/4 cup allulose.

notes: The blacker the banana, the sweeter and more flavorful the bread.
